# ZXPRESS

> ZXPRESS is a digital library of ZX Spectrum magazines, newspapers, paper books, scene letters, and ZXNet echo conferences from the post-Soviet demoscene (1990s–2020s), with Russian and English interfaces.

ZXPRESS preserves scanned and transcribed publications for ZX Spectrum users and researchers. Primary language of the archive is Russian; many pages also have English titles or summaries. Last reviewed 2026-07-24.

## Sections

- [Diskmags (electronic press)](https://zxpress.ru/ru/ezines): Catalog of ZX Spectrum electronic newspapers and magazines
- [Periodicals](https://zxpress.ru/ru/periodicals): Paper magazines and newspapers
- [Books](https://zxpress.ru/books.php): Paper books for ZX Spectrum
- [Paper letters (snailmail)](https://zxpress.ru/ru/snailmail): Scanned 1990s scene correspondence (swapping / snailmail)
- [ZXNet](https://zxpress.ru/zxnet): ZXNet Fido-style echo conferences
- [Article categories](https://zxpress.ru/ru/categories): Thematic tree of ezine articles
- [Authors](https://zxpress.ru/ru/authors): Authors of articles, letters and publications
- [Gallery](https://zxpress.ru/gallery.php): Image gallery from the archive
- [Updates](https://zxpress.ru/updates.php): Latest additions to the library
- [News](https://zxpress.ru/news): Site news
- [English diskmags](https://zxpress.ru/en/ezines): English-language entry to the diskmags catalog

## Optional

- [Guestbook](https://zxpress.ru/guestbook.php): Public visitor comments
- [Chronology](https://zxpress.ru/chronology.php): Timeline of Spectrum press activity
- [Stats](https://zxpress.ru/stats.php): Archive statistics
- [About / whois](https://zxpress.ru/whois.php): Project information
- [Sitemap](https://zxpress.ru/sitemap.xml): Full XML sitemap of indexable pages
- [Robots](https://zxpress.ru/robots.txt): Crawler rules
